title: Gilgamesh
oneliner: The first human to be terrified of dying and to write it down.

title: Qin Shi Huang
oneliner: The most powerful man alive drank mercury because someone told him it was the key to eternal life.

title: Luigi Cornaro
oneliner: A dying aristocrat stripped his diet to almost nothing and lived to nearly 100, then wrote books telling everyone else to do the same.

title: James Bedford
oneliner: A dying professor bet everything on being frozen, and 59 years later he is still waiting to wake up.
